text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Curren Bouquetd'or—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking where Curren Bouquetd'or pointed, I saw a crane game filled with plushies inspired by Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: Staring like that... is there something you want?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Uh, ah—well...
I was just wondering... what kind of flowers
would make a beautiful harmony with those girls—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I just thought—that there's a flower
that suits each and every one of them, you see...
choice_data_list: Then, shall we grab a few and try them out?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: I want to see how you look with flowers, too.
Because I want to see how it matches with the flowers too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I will properly cheer—
for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
